title: Consolidated
subtitle: BDG · FCST · Monthly sales for your unit

crossYear.description: BDG values consolidate distinct annual budgets. Use the year buttons to analyze a single fiscal year.

noOrcamento.global: No approved budget for the selected period.
noOrcamento.globalHint: Wait for the Budget Run to be loaded by the administrator.
noOrcamento.unit: Your unit does not have an approved budget for the selected period.
noOrcamento.unitHint: Contact the administrator if there is a discrepancy.

tableHeaders.avgAchievementTooltip: Achievement Index: percentage of actual sales relative to the forecast FCST (Sales ÷ FCST × 100). Values below 100% indicate FCST exceeded sales; above 100% means sales exceeded the forecast.
tableHeaders.historyTooltip: Click a badge to see the detailed history of the product. Each badge shows the achievement index for that cycle.

cronicos.emptyHint: SKUs with persistent deviation (>15% in 3 cycles) will appear here.
cronicos.filterPlaceholder: Filter by unit, family, class or product…

evolutionSubtitle: Hover over a point and click to see the division breakdown
clickDivisionHint: Click a division to go to the breakdown
viewDivisionFamilies: View families and products for this division

breakdown.unitEvolutionTooltip: Monthly volumes in the selected window: bars = actual sales; dashed line = BDG; blue line = approved FCST.

kpi.deltaFctsOrcTooltip: Percentage deviation between total FCST and BDG accumulated in the selected month window.
kpi.deltaVendasFctsTooltip: Compares total actual sales with total FCST in the window: (Sales ÷ FCST − 1) × 100. Positive means sales above approved forecast.
kpi.tendenciaTooltip: Compares average FCST of the first half of the period with the second half: ((2nd half avg ÷ 1st half avg) − 1) × 100. Positive (▲) means volume is accelerating; negative (▼) means it is declining.
kpi.coberturaOrcTooltip: Number of months where FCST reached at least 95% of BDG. Measures delivery consistency across the selected window.

table.deltaAATooltip: Deviation between FCST and prior-year sales for the same period (PY), counting only months with prior-year sales: (FCST ÷ PY Sales − 1) × 100. Months without prior-year sales are ignored on both sides.

tooltips.bias: Average FCST bias vs. actual sales in months of the period with valid data. Calculated only with volumes confirmed in approved cycles.
tooltips.fctsVsOrc: Sum of FCST vs. the annual BDG of your unit. The % indicates the degree of budget achievement.
tooltips.salesVsOrc: Accumulated sales from January to the last closed month of the year. The % compares to the period FCST (months already realized).
tooltips.accuracy: FCST accuracy vs. actual sales in months of the period with valid data. Calculated only with volumes confirmed in approved cycles.
